## Description

What feature would you like to see?

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who would benefit?

## Proposed Solution

How should this feature work? What would the user experience be?

## Example Use Case

```
Describe how someone would use this feature
```

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered other approaches?

## Additional Context

- Phase alignment: Which phase in ROADMAP.md does this relate to?
- Priority: Critical / High / Medium / Low
- Complexity estimate: Simple / Moderate / Complex

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] I read MISSION.md and ROADMAP.md
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] This aligns with the project vision
